headline: Coosalud Schedules Tranche Transfers Before Exiting Intervention
summary: Coosalud has scheduled the transfer of 481.879 billion pesos to 1,127 healthcare providers through Adres, covering subsidized and contributory payments before exiting government intervention.
why: Liquidity flows to healthcare providers impact the financial stability of the broader healthcare delivery network.

impacts.name: Coosalud
impacts.why: Settlement of pending provider payments marks exit from state intervention.
